pox.m: A common venereal disease caused by the treponema pallidum spirochete; symptoms change through progressive stages; can be congenital (transmitted through the placenta).

poxes.m: A common venereal disease caused by the treponema pallidum spirochete; symptoms change through progressive stages; can be congenital (transmitted through the placenta).

poxvirus.m: Any of a group of viruses that can cause pox diseases in vertebrates.

poxviruses.m: Any of a group of viruses that can cause pox diseases in vertebrates.
